title: Empirical Bayes Variable Selection with Lasso Statistics in the AMP Framework
summary: The Lasso is one of the most ubiquitous methods for variable selection in high-dimensional linear regression and has been studied extensively under different regimes. In a particular asymptotic setup entailing $n/p\to \text{constant}$, an i.i.d.~Gaussian $X$ matrix and linear sparsity, \citet{su2017false} analyzed the Lasso selection path and presented negative results, showing that maintaining small levels of the false discovery proportion comes at a substantial cost in power.
